business_summary: China Reform Health Management and Services Group Co., Ltd. offers medical insurance management services in China. The company provides medical insurance fund management, medical quality and safety, drug and medical device supervision, and internet-based health protection services. It is also involved in the pharmaceutical and medical business. The company was formerly known as SeaRainbow Holding Corp. and changed its name to China Reform Health Management and Services Group Co., Ltd. in May 2018. China Reform Health Management and Services Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: 중국개혁건강관리서비스그룹유한회사는 중국에서 의료보험 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 의료 보험 기금 관리, 의료 품질 및 안전, 의약품 및 의료 기기 감독, 인터넷 기반 건강 보호 서비스를 제공합니다. 제약 및 의료 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 SeaRainbow Holding Corp.로 알려져 있었으며 2018년 5월에 China Reform Health Management and Services Group Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Reform Health Management and Services Group Co., Ltd.는 1986년에 설립되었으며 중국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
